signals.title: Initial jobless claims (moved to Wednesday for Thanksgiving): Jobless claims came in at 189K against a 201K forecast, below expectations

facts.text: Jobless claims came in at 189K against a 201K forecast, below expectations.
The previous reading was 203K, revised to 202K.
The initial claims reading was the lowest since week to Jul 18.

why.text: Initial claims count new unemployment insurance applications. The four-week average smooths weekly swings.

counter.text: First estimates are revised; the next release can change the picture.

next.text: See the Displace calendar for the next release in this series.

signals.title: PCE inflation · Personal income and outlays (Oct): Core PCE came in at 0.3% against a 0.3% forecast, in line with expectations

facts.text: Core PCE came in at 0.3% against a 0.3% forecast, in line with expectations.
PCE m/m 0.3% (previous 0.5%); Core PCE y/y 3.3% (previous 3.1%); Personal spending m/m 0.3% (previous 0.6%).

why.text: The Fed measures its inflation target using headline PCE. Core PCE helps identify the underlying trend.

signals.title: GDP, second estimate (Q3): GDP came in at 4.3% against a 3.5% forecast, above expectations

facts.text: GDP came in at 4.3% against a 3.5% forecast, above expectations.
The real GDP, annualized reading was the highest since Q3 2023.

why.text: Headline U.S. GDP growth is annualized. Subsequent estimates add data and may revise the same quarter.
